A simple majority of the total membership
Two-thirds of the members present and voting

s:

2. Protection of railways within the State.
3. All matters relating to public order in the State.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: Article 257 covers communications of national or military importance and protection of railways. Public order is not included in the listed Article 257 direction powers.

s: A State Government persistently fails to comply with directions issued by the Union under the constitutional scheme. Which provision enables the President to hold that the State government cannot be carried on in accordance with the Constitution?
x: Article 365 permits the President to hold that a State government cannot be carried on in accordance with the Constitution when the State fails to comply with Union directions. This can open the way to action under Article 356.

s: Which of the following statements correctly describes the effect of different emergencies on Union directions to States?
o: A Financial Emergency automatically transfers all State executive power to the Union.

During a National Emergency, directions may extend to any matter; during a Financial Emergency, directions concern canons of financial propriety.
Both emergencies permit directions only regarding protection of railways.
x: A National Emergency permits Union directions on any matter, whereas a Financial Emergency is associated with directions concerning canons of financial propriety.
tq: Compare the scope of Union directions under the two emergencies without treating them as identical.

The Governor, without the consent of the Union Government
The Supreme Court, with the consent of the President
Parliament, only with the consent of the State Legislature

Parliament entrusts Union functions to States with State consent.
The Union Cabinet entrusts State functions to the Governor without consent.
The President entrusts State functions to the Union without consent.

Abolish the distinction between Union and State subjects

s: Article 261 of the Constitution provides for which of the following?
o: Uniformity of service conditions in All-India Services
Distribution of financial resources between the Union and the States
Full faith and credit throughout India to public acts, records and judicial proceedings
Adjudication of inter-State river water disputes
x: Article 261 requires full faith and credit throughout India to public acts, records and judicial proceedings of the Union and every State.
tq: Directly match the Article with its constitutional principle.
sec: Full faith and credit to public acts, records and judicial proceedings  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

s: A final civil court judgment delivered in one State is sought to be executed in another State. Which constitutional provision facilitates this?
x: Article 261(3) provides that final judgments and orders of civil courts in any part of India may be executed anywhere within India according to law.
tq: Apply the constitutional rule to a concrete inter-State enforcement situation.
sec: Full faith and credit to public acts, records and judicial proceedings  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

s:
Consider the following statements about Article 261:
1. It applies to public acts, records and judicial proceedings of the Union and every State.
2. Its operation is confined to the State in which the act or record originated.
3. Final civil court judgments may be executed anywhere in India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Article 261 extends the principle throughout India, so statement 2 is false.
tq: Reject the territorial-limitation trap in statement 2.
sec: Full faith and credit to public acts, records and judicial proceedings  [APPSC, GROUP-II]
